findings.name: A high-priority task was held up by lower-priority work
findings.impact: The most urgent part of your program waits for work that should never delay it, so it can miss its deadline even though the CPU had time for it.
findings.summary: task_p3 (prio 3) was blocked 500.67 ms on a semaphore released by task_p1 (prio 1); for 398.59 ms of that, task_p1 was ready but task_p2 (prio 2), proc_pool_thread (prio 21) held its CPU. Seen 1x.
findings.qnx: QNX semaphores have no owner, so the kernel cannot apply priority inheritance. A pthread mutex (priority inheritance is the QNX default) would have boosted task_p1 to priority 3 and the medium-priority work could not have preempted it.

radar.name: task_p3
radar.summary: task_p3 (prio 3) behaved unlike healthy QNX programs in 26 of its 37 time windows; the most unusual stretch lasted 520 ms. It stands out in: time blocked on a semaphore (higher than healthy), time blocked while a lower-priority thread held its CPU (higher than healthy), longest single block (higher than healthy). The closest pattern TraceLens has seen is priority inversion through a semaphore used as a lock, but only loosely (distance 9.47 against 1.062 typical for it): treat this as behaviour of its own.

radar.name: task_p1
radar.summary: task_p1 (prio 1) behaved unlike healthy QNX programs in 37 of its 46 time windows; the most unusual stretch lasted 520 ms. It stands out in: longest wait for a CPU (higher than healthy), time waiting for a CPU (higher than healthy), time asleep (lower than healthy). The closest pattern TraceLens has seen is an interrupt handler working with its line still masked (distance 0.15, inside the 0.705 typical for that pattern).

remedies.title: Replace semaphore 'sem' (used as a lock) with a priority-inheriting mutex
remedies.rationale: A POSIX semaphore has no owner, so the QNX kernel cannot raise the priority of the thread that holds it: a medium-priority thread preempts the holder and the high-priority waiter waits for both. A pthread mutex has an owner; with PTHREAD_PRIO_INHERIT (the QNX default) the holder runs at the waiter's priority until it unlocks.
